task.title: Show Blame
task.shortdesc: See who last changed each line of a file, and jump to the commit behind any line.

step.cmd:
Right-click a file (in the
area, the editor, the Project view, or the DITA Maps Manager) and select Show Blame.

stepresult.p:
The editor colors each line by the commit that last changed it. Clicking a line filters the
view to that file and selects its commit, so you can see the full change.

step.cmd: To turn the coloring off, select Hide Blame from the same contextual menu.

stepresult.p:
The blame highlights are removed without closing the editor, and the
file filter is cleared so the panel shows the full repository history again.
